CORE MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 13
   C. 170
   D. 169

2. Solve for x: x + 8 = 16. (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 9
   C. 8
   D. 8

3. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 156
   C. 144
   D. 24

4. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 11
   C. 22
   D. 122

5. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 90
   C. 81
   D. 36

6. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 13
   C. 3
   D. 41

7. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 24
   C. 42
   D. 36

8. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 12 cm³
   B. 9 cm³
   C. 27 cm³
   D. 18 cm³

9. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 48
   C. 49
   D. 14

10. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 14
   C. 10
   D. 2

11. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 10 000 m²
   B. 1000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 100 000 m²

12. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 3
   C. 17
   D. 21

13. Solve for x: x + 5 = 11. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 5
   C. 11
   D. 6

14. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
